originalFlatSource.'notes'.5.2.'Item1': i... i felt myself dying. it was all so sudden, there was blood everywhere and i couldnt keep my eyes open. i was scared... but i didnt want to give up. i found so many cool things in this place and i feel like ive made so much progress in this mission. im not gonna stop here. i will make it through all of this shit. i will see my friends again.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.5.3.'Item1':
i didnt think that monster would find me again, but it did. it knew my face, my mistakes... but not my rifle. when it finally burst open, i saw that pickaxe. i saw the etching i scratched into it, the same as the etching they scratched into my pickaxe. i saw the chip from when they tried to dig up some titanium to gift me. and then, suddenly, i saw it happening again. the smell of grating steel. the tremours of the ground. the sound of dismembering flesh. the taste of sweat and blood, as i tried to run, dropping the food i was bringing back to the pod-
<>
am i supposed to feel at ease now? or am i just bargaining for peace, to be broken when another finds me?
originalFlatSource.'notes'.5.4.'Item1': I want to leave this place, I am terrorized, I don't have words to describe what I just experienced, it was a big, horrid creature with hundreds of teeth, ready to devour me, it chase after me for what I've felt hours, it destroys everything on its path. It stopped only after I've went so far away that I was completely lost, it drained my food, water, tools, even my own sanity, I just want this to end.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.6.0.'Item1': way too cold in here. have to try my best to not get wet at all, or ill be in big trouble. lucky us, there are a lot of those weird sporey plants that give off some heat, along with those weird machines. run between those when possible, i guess. better not get stuck in the freezing cold.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.6.1.'Item1': dune cold. dig warm not warm enough. dune eat fur friend. eat raw! dune has fur. fur warm for dune. dune full and warm. dune happy not cold.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.6.2.'Item1': its cold down here, i keep having to duck into lifepods to warm up… although sometimes theres these little humming stoves that i can stop by for warmth, i just need to be careful not to touch them for too long, they make me feel sick. just enough to warm up and then keep going. if i were you id play it safe and look out for anything digging towards me when im resting. i can hear stuff tunneling around me.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.7.0.'Item1': It's odd how it rains here. I've never actually seen real rain before... It's rather pretty, even if unsanitary. I still wonder how it is possible for there to be such a higher water concentration down here. Perhaps, the water from the above ice cap is dripping down to here?
originalFlatSource.'notes'.7.1.'Item1': found some weird bouncey things. they sent me flying... but i could keep my feet pointed down. its pretty fun. maybe could be useful sometimes, too. kind of dangerous maybe, but what isnt down here.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.7.2.'Item1':
I dont know what hit me but I cant feel my leg anymore, all I can see is a tangled mess of muscle bone and blood
my body is screaming for the agony to end 
the only thing I have is this blue device on my chest. I was told by the trader I bought it from that it should only be used in emergencies.
The pain is not unbearable anymore, but the light is blinking now. I dont know how long I have left. will the darkness return when this thing runs out? I dont want to fade away...
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.0.'Item1': every single one of these growths here seems like it has some kind of effect... i dont know what exactly. its unpredictable. but there are patterns to it. some are safe, some arent, some are helpful. i'll try to write things down as i figure it out...
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.1.'Item1': ..ugh. okay. the yellow ones HURT. feels kind of similar to the coils i found a few hours back... they usually have some kind of weird zappy field around them... don't touch them. its not good. for your body, at least. i noticed it did somehow recharge all my batteries after touching...
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.2.'Item1': this geiger counter i have goes crazy when around one of the green growths. some kind of "radiation", whatever that is. im pretty sure its bad for you. avoid being near those if you can.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.3.'Item1': noticed some of these are weirdly fragile. they shatter when i touch them at all. youll see they look really brittle, there's cracks all over them. weirdly enough, this seems to also appear alongside some of the other types ive seen... wonder if this is the case for all of them.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.4.'Item1': noticed a lot of the growths either push me away or pull me in. you can feel some kind of force going through you when that happens. could prove useful sometimes
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.5.'Item1': gosh. i am SO glad i had an ice pack on me. it seems like the foggy, shimmery ones rapidly heat things up around them... including me. i wouldnt be surprised if some did the opposite. i heard this weird sound coming from them too...
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.6.'Item1': make sure you have some antibiotics n such. i think the purple ones mess with your immune system. they have a vague purple haze around them... i sat next to one for a while to rest, and noticed my vital signs dropping on my chip. seems like some kind of sepsis response. i think i'll be fine
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.7.'Item1': okay. the shakey ones look really scary... they aren't. they send you flying... but, like, i can keep my feet pointed down the entire time. kind of similar to the bouncey things in the previous area i was in.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.8.8.'Item1':
...

<>the flying things. i dont know how they did that. holy... oh god. im fine now, but...<>

how to say this... theres weird sharp flying things. they make really weird loud noises... almost as if theyre laughign at me. they wind up sometimes and charge at me, trying to stab me. they got me once or twice, but... whenever they did that, they got stuck in the ground and i hit it a few times until it... uh... not sure... what happened, but it was gone. i think it came from one of the growths, but it was kind of moving.<>

i got something after it disappeared... maybe its useful? it feels like its growing into something, ill wait and see.

[BIOMETRIC REPORT - 25##-11-19-18-49-58-4587]
<>
ENTITY CLASS: Biological
ENTITY SUBCLASS: Sawian
ENTITY NAME: Experiment
<>
[CONTENTS]

The stable biological version of our newest project is ready.
It appears that, mentally, there wasn't and will be nothing left of our original human volunteer, not to mention the rest of the subjects.
Despite that, they seem to be learning fast, and are not retaliating.
<>
The DNA combination caused the Experiment to be considerably smaller in stature than a human person, and lack fat and muscle mass.
Despite this, it's muscle and bone density is much higher. This will assumbly result in the specimen being resilient to various forms of physical trauma... And give it a hard time swimming.
It has three protrusions at the back of its skull, of form similar to ear cartilage. Somehow, it has an ear structure similar to that of an avian - must've been lying around somewhere in the DNA we spliced.
It is thinly furred, and has pink-ish yellow-ish flesh, as seen on wounds and on the inside of the mouth.
Its hands are some kind of combination between a canine's and a homosapiens'. I know one of my co-workers is going to enjoy the paws-
Somehow, the bioluminescent eyes from our earlier prototypes of this species have stayed. We are yet to determine the exact effects this has on their sight.
<>
We will soon clone this specimen 30 times to conduct destructive testing on the clones. We will leave a few to naturally reproduce, to save on resources.

[END]

<>
[CONTENTS]

Reduction of Corporate Waste Objective
<>
32 Sawians were recruited randomly among those at our site fro<corrupt:0xFFFFFF> Baseline characteristics were: 25 SAW-01, 4 SAW-05, 3 SAW-12. The subjects were randomly assigned to 8 groups of 4 subjects each. Each group were subject to one choice in three types of conditions: consuming Sawian or Terran meat, consuming raw or as soup, and observing or being ignorant of the source of the meat.

Meat was sourced from the Indicent on [25##-12-30].
<>
While the SAW-01 and SAW-05 in all groups which consumed the Sawian meat, regardless of whether they observed the source of the meat, displayed extreme negative emotion upon consumption, the SAW-12 did not display the same negative emotions. No Sawians which consumed the terran meat displayed negative emotions, presumably as they did not recognize the meat as their own, although complaints were raised about eating noncooked food. No Sawians which consumed the meat in soup form displayed negative emotions, even if they had observed the source.

The SAW-12 displayed an aberrant apathy towards consuming raw Sawian meat, as expected. We might be able to repurpose discarded specimens as food for any SAW-12s on site.

[END]

This memorandum establishes mandatory terminology policy regarding the Sawian species and supersedes all prior documentation, annotations, and informal usage.

Effective immediately, the term "hermaphrodite" is **banned in all corporate communications**, including scientific, operational, cultural, and casual contexts. The sole exception is explicit historical reference (e.g., quotations, legacy documentation analysis, or discussion of obsolete Earth taxonomies), which must be clearly labeled as such.

Context-dependent alternatives include "cosexual" and "monoecious."

<>
No human naturally possesses two fully functional reproductive systems. The appropriate human medical and social term is "intersex", not "hermaphrodite". The latter term originated from the mythological figure Hermaphroditus and has long been associated with stigma, violence, and dehumanization. This includes the use of this term to refer to animals, thus equating intersex humans with animals. This has thus proven volatile in public, academic, and media-facing environments.

The application of this term to non-human species arose from that same framework and is therefore neither neutral nor acceptable, regardless of biological differences.
<>
While historical alternatives exist, such as "eunuch", "bisexual", and "androgyny", these have taken on new meanings and connotations and are not appropriate to use in this way either.

Do not project human gender or sex frameworks onto Sawian subjects. Reproductive biology does not imply gender identity, presentation, orientation, or social function.

Reproductive terminology is not casual vocabulary and should not be treated as such.

[BIOMETRIC REPORT - 25##-08-04-09-05-25-1057]
[Project: "A day in the life"]
----------------------------------------------<>
So.
This is my "journal" now. Which is apparently a written work describing one's life and experiences.
I am not entirely sure why the coats have me doing this, but the same can be said about most things they make us do.
Still, I got lucky today. It can get way worse than a writing exercise.
I find this device quite fascinating, and it is a shame that I will part with it in just a few hours. But I have been given a task, and I shall complete it.<>

We usually are woken up either by eachother, or by the first food buzzer ringing. Rarely do we wake up to testing immediately.
I'm not sure what "hour" this happens at... Hell, I barely understand the concept. Though, I hear the coats talking about it all the time...

Anyway, we wake up and soon it's time for our very first meal of the day.
What they feed us is slightly varied, which wasn't the case just a few years ago. Still mostly just nutrient bars, though. They're really bland, but I can't complain...

--------------------------------------------------<>
It's some hours later now.

This is the time when the coats hunt.
They call you out by the number, and you have to come to them.
Or they come for you. 
You do not want that.
Sometimes, they call out multiple numbers... It's usually a good sign, though.<>

What they'll do to you is up to chance, really.
The tests can be harmless, they can be terrible, or they can be beneficial.
It's worth noting that the coats merely TRY to do things, and while sometimes they try to help, those attempts are usually far less successful than the ones where they try to mess you up.<>

Two numbers are called, and two others stand up, their faces worried.
One of them is healthy. Far more likely to get hurt.

The other has four arms.
One on the left, and three on the right.
Well, if you could call the weird growths arms. They look kinda close?
They were originally born with two. The coats decided that to be too much one day, and removed one.
The next day, they came back with ELEVEN arms.
The humans removed ten of those, only to grace them with seven new ones.
The next day it was five.
Today it's four.

They are getting close now.<>

The poor fellow is called Arms. And I swear, this was their name BEFORE this whole ordeal, and it's widely believed that humans picked them because of that.
Perhaps it's their idea of a joke?

[BIOMETRIC REPORT - 25##-08-04-09-05-25-1057]
[Project: "A day in the life"]
----------------------------------------------
<>
It's quiet. Those who get lucky often just rest; sometimes they socialize. Usually, they just worry about those who got taken.
This concept of "Hours", this cycle, schedule... It's terrifying.
I don't understand it. Why is each sleep cycle divided into 24 (?) hours? What governs such rules? Even the humans play by it.
Is something above them controlling it?
<>

Some more hours later, the first test subjects start to trickle back in.
Best-case scenario, they walk in on their own. Quite common, actually.
Sometimes they are carried in.
Rarely, two guards come in instead. They head straight to someone's cot and take away their things.
If it were your friend, and the guards are some of the nicer ones, they will let you keep a thing or two.
I don't really have anyone to wait for anymore, so I just watch those who do. Everyone is used to this, but the nerves are always present.
<>

Dinner time.
The meal dispensers dropped some cooked meat on my plate. Lucky. Better than breakfast, for sure.
Some others hum approvingly, as they get similarly lucky. Others grumble as they get served the same old nutrient bars. It's really like they are feeding us with whatever they have on hand... Maybe this is a test, too?
Sometimes fights break out over the food, but that's rare. The guards are not happy anytime this happens.
 
People talk. They play. They sing.
Some nurse their wounds, or help others nurse theirs.
It's a calm time.
The coats are done for the time being.

Later.
In about an "hour", our last meal of the day will be served.
Bedtime soon after that.
There is not much more to say, really.

Actually, there is one thing. Very rarely, extra tests will be called around this time. Well, the humans call them "Relocations" or "Assignments."
<>
You never come back when you get called to one of those. But they always allow you to take your things. I am not sure if it's because they are really taking you somewhere else, or they simply want to expedite the process of emptying your place by having you do it yourself.
<>

<>

<>
Serendipitously, this solves our abnormally high food usage problem, for now. No one will question why our food delivery department is using food.
<>

originalFlatTarget.'other'.'startlorenote':
2XXX년 
<>
인류는 눈부신 기술적 진보를 이룩했다. 과거에는 불가능하다고 여겼던 일들이 이제는 당연한 일상이 되었다.
<>
그 중심에는 한 기업이 있었다. 이 기업의 발전은 기적 같았으나, 그 뒤에 숨겨진 비밀은 철저히 베일에 싸여 있었다.
<>
수년 전 이 기업은 새로운 종족을 창조했다. 동물과 인간의 DNA를 결합한 이 생명체를, 이들은 간단하게 "엑스페리먼트"라 불렀다.
<>
이 실험체들은 인간과 흡사하면서도 마음대로 부릴 수 있어 완벽한 실험 대상이었다. 기업은 이들을 쥐어짜 내고, 자신들의 입맛에 맞게 생체 구조를 더 뒤틀었다. 해가 지나갈수록 그 개체수는 더 늘어만 갔다.

그 누구도 결코 바깥세상을 보지 못하리라.
<>
이제 지구는 이 기업의 야망을 담기엔 턱없이 부족한 그릇인 듯했다. 순간이동 기술이 새로이 고안되자, 이들은 생명이 풍부한 한 회색 행성에 눈길을 돌렸다.
<>
얼마 지나지 않아, 잡다한 화물과 쓰레기가 무더기로 보내졌다.
<>
보정이 어려웠기에 행성의 표면에 도달한 것만큼 많은 양이 행성의 동굴 망에 떨어졌지만, 프로젝트 자체는 순조롭게 진행되었다.
<>
정체불명의 오류로 중요한 기술 부품이 동굴 깊숙한 곳으로 전송되기 전까지는.
<>
곧 과학자들이 계획을 세웠다. 자신들에게는 위험이 거의 없는 계획을.
<>
성공할 가능성은 낮았지만, 살아 있는 총알받이는 넘쳐났다.
<>

우리 최신 프로젝트의 안정적인 생물학적 버전이 준비되었습니다.
정신적으로는, 원래 인간 자원 봉사자는 남아있지 않을 것이며, 다른 피험자들도 마찬가지입니다.
그럼에도 불구하고, 그들은 빠르게 배우고 저항하지 않습니다.
<>
DNA 조합으로 인해 실험체는 인간보다 훨씬 작고 지방과 근육량이 부족합니다.
그럼에도 불구하고, 근육과 뼈 밀도는 훨씬 높습니다. 이는 피험자가 다양한 형태의 신체적 외상에 강하다는 것을 의미합니다… 그리고 수영하기 어렵게 만들 것입니다.
두개골 뒤쪽에 귀 연골과 유사한 형태의 돌기 세 개가 있습니다. 어떻게든, 조류와 유사한 귀 구조를 가지고 있습니다. DNA를 섞을 때 어딘가에 있었던 것 같습니다.
피부는 얇게 털로 덮여 있고, 상처와 입 안쪽에서 볼 수 있는 분홍색-노란색 살을 가지고 있습니다.
그의 손은 개와 호모 사피엔스의 조합과 같습니다. 동료 중 한 명이 이것을 즐길 것이라고 생각합니다.
어떻게든, 이전 프로토타입의 생체 발광 눈이 남아 있습니다. 이것이 시력에 미치는 정확한 영향은 아직 파악하지 못했습니다.
<>
우리는 이 피험체를 30번 복제하여 복제본에 대한 파괴 테스트를 수행할 것입니다. 자원을 절약하기 위해 몇몇은 자연적으로 번식하도록 내버려둘 것입니다.

우리 현장에서 무작위로 모집된 32명의 소우인이 기준 특성은 다음과 같습니다: SAW-01 25명, SAW-05 4명, SAW-12 3명. 피험자들은 각 그룹에 4명씩, 8개의 그룹으로 무작위로 배정되었습니다. 각 그룹은 세 가지 유형의 조건 중 하나에 적용되었습니다: 소우인 또는 지구인 고기를 섭취, 생으로 또는 수프로 섭취, 고기 출처를 관찰하거나 무시. 

고기는 [25##-12-30]의 사건에서 조달되었습니다.
<>
모든 그룹에서 소우인 고기를 섭취한 SAW-01과 SAW-05는 고기 출처를 관찰했는지 여부에 관계없이 섭취 시 극심한 부정적인 감정을 보였지만, SAW-12는 동일한 부정적인 감정을 보이지 않았습니다. 지구인 고기를 섭취한 소우인은 부정적인 감정을 보이지 않았는데, 아마도 고기가 자신의 고기라고 인식하지 않았기 때문일 것입니다. 하지만 익히지 않은 음식을 먹는 것에 대한 불만이 제기되었습니다. 고기를 수프 형태로 섭취한 소우인은 고기 출처를 관찰했더라도 부정적인 감정을 보이지 않았습니다.

SAW-12는 예상대로 생 소우인 고기를 섭취하는 것에 대해 이상한 무관심을 보였습니다. 현장에 있는 SAW-12에게 버려진 표본을 음식으로 재활용할 수 있을 것입니다.

보낸 사람: <corrupt:0xFFFFDC>

국가 규제 위원회와 홀로콜을 마쳤어. 음식 텔레포트 시스템을 판매해도 좋아! 이제 단일 사용 포장 금지를 추진할 수 있어. 그리고 우리 음식 상자가 변질에 강하기 때문에 음식물 쓰레기(그리고 손실이 많은 해들)는 과거의 일이 될 거야. 그리고 요즘 사람들은 너무 게을러서 이 기술을 다른 것에도 적용할 수 있을 거야.
<>
드롭박스의 열 차폐를 강화하는 것을 잊지 마. 실패율은 500분의 1 미만이긴 하지만... 알다시피, E=mc2이고 c가 너무 크면, 건포도 만한 질량도 붕괴되어 블랙홀이 되어 즉시(10^-25초 이내) 호킹 복사로 증발하고 히로시마에 투하된 핵폭탄과 동일한 에너지를 생성해. 이 현상이 발생했을 때 텔레포트를 되돌리는 시스템이 점점 더 좋아지고 있으며 대부분의 에너지를 제거할 수 있지만, 더 이상 누출되도록 할 수 없어.
<>
뜻밖에도 이것은 우리 비정상적으로 높은 음식 사용량 문제를 해결해 줘. 지금은 아무도 우리 음식 배달 부서가 왜 음식을 사용하는지 의심하지 않을 거야.

다른 우주에서는 무한 에너지 아이디어를 추구했을까 궁금할 때가 있어?

originalFlatSource.'description': The official developer-created english locale of the game. You can find community translations in the locale repository (<color="blue">https://github.com/Orsoniks/scavgame-locale</color>), though those translations are not quality-checked and might be innacurate or out of date.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bandagedsc': A roll of dressing with a bandage, used to slow down bleeding, stabilize fractures and aid skin healing. Has no effect on muscle health.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'rippeddressingdsc': A small pile of ripped clothing. Can be used as a makeshift bandage for bleeding wounds.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'ragdsc': A worn, crumpled up rag. Can be used as decent makeshift dressing. Use in the inventory to dry yourself.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'analgesicgauzedsc': Woven gauze made of cotton, containing analgesic drugs. Decent at slowing bleeding and reducing pain from injuries.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'alginatedsc': Dressing derived from carbohydrate sources released by clinical bacterial species, in the same manner as biofilm formation. Slows bleeding, highly improves skin healing and counteracts infections
originalFlatSource.'main'.'sterilizedbandagedsc': A roll of dressing with a bandage, used to slow down bleeding, stabilize fractures and aid skin healing. Counteracts infections. Has no effect on muscle health.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'plasticbandagedsc': A roll of specially synthesized tough material, made to efficiently cover wounds and stabilize fractures. Has no effect on muscle health.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'adhesivebandagedsc': A pack of small medical dressings, made to treat small injuries. Lowers bleeding.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'musharmdsc': Inedible plant part, useful as a one-time makeshift bandage. Can be used as foliage for crafing.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'paincreamdsc': A small 100ml bottle used to hold relief cream. Dosage is 10ml.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'morphinedsc': A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. The overdose label reads 88ml.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'makeshiftlrddsc': A makeshift Localized Resuscitation Device. Looks like it's taped together. Increases the muscle health and disinfects limb it's used on, AND any directly adjacent limbs. Slightly reduces internal bleeding if used on the chest. Requires at least 25mL of LRD serum to function.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'lrddsc': A Localized Resuscitation Device, made to easily provide effective general trauma care. Increases limb health, slows bleeding, provides pain relieving drugs and disinfects the limb it's used on, along with any adjacent limbs. Highly reduces internal bleeding if used on the chest. Requires at least 25mL of LRD serum to function.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'opiumdsc': A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. The overdose label says 200ml.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'heroindsc': A 150ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. This one is missing the graduation marks and dosage guides.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'naloxonedsc': A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. You can't make out the brand's name other than the "N".
originalFlatSource.'main'.'sodiumnitroprussidedsc': A 100ml bottle with sodium nitroprusside. As the medication only works intravenously, you will need to get a separate syringe to fill and use.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'vasopressindsc': A 100ml bottle with vasopressin. As the medication only works intravenously, you will need to get a separate syringe to fill and use.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'amiodaronedsc': A 100ml bottle with amiodarone. As the medication only works intravenously, you will need to get a separate syringe to fill and use.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'fentanyldsc': A 100ml syringe that can inject fluid intravenously. This one comes with diluted fentanyl for pain relief. The overdose label reads 20ml.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'autopumpdsc': While worn, pumps blood in place of your heart using a simple mechanism and an internal battery, keeping your blood pressure at livable levels. Might buy you more time to fix whatever catastrophe has befallen you.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'aeddsc': An electronic device that diagnoses life-threatening cardiac arrhythmias and treats them via electric shocks. Use on the upper torso. Compared to a manual defibrillator, it does not require training, but takes longer to work and uses more power.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'manualdefibrillatordsc': An electronic device used to stabilize dangerous heart rhythms. Use on the upper torso. This one is manual, and will require some know-how to use correctly. Compared to an AED, it's faster and uses less power, but isn't guaranteed to work. Higher INT makes operation easier.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'antidepressantsdsc': A 140ml pill bottle of antidepressants. Dosage is 20ml.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'antibioticsdsc': A 100ml pill bottle of antibiotic pills. Dosage is 20ml.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'antiserumdsc': A 100ml syringe with an autoinjector at the end. Dosage is 50ml.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'antiraddsc': A 100ml pill bottle with a cool radiation sign on it. Dosage is 20ml.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'sleepingpillsdsc': A blister pack containing 25ml worth of pills. Dosage is 5ml. The brand name is missing.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'rosepoddsc': A part of a sand rose. Doesn't spoil. Can be opened.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'roselightdsc': A bright, far reaching yellow light that came from a sand rose. While it decays fast, it's useful for checking how big a drop is. Also reveals hidden infections if used on a limb.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'splintdsc': A sturdy board, made to aid fractures. Helps with healing fractures and dislocations. Putting it on a functional limb will still immobilize it, reducing your capabilities.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bloodbagdsc': A 0.75L plastic bag with an autoinjector at the end. Injects 375mL on use. Use in the inventory to draw blood from yourself.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bloodsacdsc': A small, fleshy sac with blood in it. Doesn't look too different from your blood. Can be eaten or used in crafting.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'venomglanddsc': A tiny salivary gland that produces and stores hemotoxin. You could probably process it into some kind of anti-venom.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'salinedsc': A 0.75L bag with a needle at the end, for injecting fluids intravenously.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'ringersolutiondsc': A 0.7L bag with a needle at the end, for injecting fluids intravenously.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bloodbaghumandsc': A 0.75L plastic bag with an autoinjector at the end. Injects 375mL on use. Use in the inventory to draw blood from yourself. There's traces of red on it.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'flammablepowderdsc': A chalky and highly flammable powder. Useful in making explosives.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'foliagebagdsc': A very flimsy bag made of tied together foliage.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'slingbagdsc': A foliage bag with added reinforcements, made to be worn on your back.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'gravbagdsc': A very experimental container that generates negative gravity in order to reduce the weight of whatever's in it. Has explosive tendencies when its battery nears empty.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'legpouchdsc': A leather pouch with straps made to go around the thigh. It's like a pocket pocket!
originalFlatSource.'main'.'liquidpouchdsc': A flexible liquid pouch made to store liquids. Has a strap to go over your belly. You can fill it with bottles and vice-versa.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'materialpouchdsc': A large, sturdy pouch that attaches to your thigh, with many small pockets to hold crafting materials. Has a high encumbrance reduction, but only accepts very small items.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'pursedsc': A handheld medium-sized bag used to carry personal items. Quite stylish!
originalFlatSource.'main'.'pouchdsc': A small green bag made of woven synthetic fiber. Has no handle.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'brokenbagdsc': An old, heavily worn school bag. The straps are torn and unusable, rendering the bag unwearable.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'toolboxdsc': A big, heavy steel box, made to hold tools.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'medkitdsc': A small box which can efficiently hold various medicines.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'scaffoldingpackdsc': A hyper-compressed box of scaffolding, made to be easily placed down. Lasts 100 uses.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'disinfectantdsc': A 0.2L plastic bottle with a spray nozzle on it. Can spray 10ml of liquid at a time.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'spraybottledsc': A 0.2L bottle with a spray nozzle on it. Sprays 10ml of liquid at a time. Good for correct use of antiseptics.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'syringedsc': A 100ml syringe which can inject fluid intravenously. It's handmade.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'scrapmetaldsc': Bits and pieces of steel from destroyed machinery. Can be placed down if above 25% condition. Commonly used as currency between survivors, and for crafting.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'climbingropedsc': A long, strengthened sheet of rope with attachment points at each end. You could place it over a large drop and use it to climb down. Has two uses.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'circuitboarddsc': A bit of circuitry, ripped out of a once working machine. It still sparks occasionally. Used in crafting.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bloodcrystalsharddsc': Seeps blood into anything it touches. Slowly increases your blood volume up to normal levels while stored on your body.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'soothingcrystalsharddsc': It has a calming aura to it. Slowly increases happiness while stored on your body.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'reliefcrystalsharddsc': You feel a little numb holding it... Decreases pain while stored on your body.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'turbulentcrystalsharddsc': It vibrates with energy. Increases jump height while stored on your body.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'oxygencrystalsharddsc': It's bubbling away slowly, releasing oxygen into anything around it... Increases stamina regeneration while stored on your body.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'emissivecrystalsharddsc': Glows brightly, for a time. Useful as a light source while it lasts.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'digestioncrystalsharddsc': It feels as if it's taking matter out of your body... Decreases sickness while stored on your body.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'geofruitdsc': Basic, but tasty fruit. Grows on geo-trees. Low in calories, reduces some thirst and decays fast.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'stonefruitcloseddsc': A hard green fruit stuck to a hard, gray part of its plant. You need to separate it using your teeth first.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'stonefruitopendsc': A hard green fruit with a neutral taste and medium fat content. It's very dry, you'll probably be thirsty after it.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bananadsc': A tasty yellow fruit, seemingly from another planet. Slightly radioactive.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'burgerdsc': A big, tasty snack. Fills both your tummy and soul!
originalFlatSource.'main'.'pancakedsc': A layered flat, sweet batter cooked on a hot surface, covered in syrup. Might get into your fur. Tasty!
originalFlatSource.'main'.'pizzaslicedsc': A slice of baked pizza. Very tasty, filling and fattening!
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bucketofchickendsc': A bunch of chicken legs in a bucket. Very filling. Has an exceedingly long shelf life.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'steakdsc': A big, nicely cooked and prepared piece of meat. Filling, fattening and tasty!
originalFlatSource.'main'.'cookiesdsc': A pack of small, baked sweet snacks. Tasty, but not the healthiest.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'chipsdsc': A pack of thin, baked slices of potato. Tasty, but not the healthiest.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'cerealdsc': A box of generic cereal. Not exactly fun to eat dry, but it's filling and not repulsive. Slightly increases thirst.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bowlofcerealdsc': A foliage bowl that can hold 0.5L of liquid. Somehow, you're unable to create it without the cereal.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'makeshifthelmetdsc': A rudimentary helmet made out of some rope and stitched together carcasses. Provides some head protection.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'hardcandydsc': A pack of small, hard candy. Tasty, but not filling.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'fleshchunkdsc': A giant, very fatty chunk of flesh. Must've came from something big. Very filling and fattening.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'candybardsc': A nice, tasty candy bar. Lasts long, but not very filling. Might make you sick if overeaten.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'chocolatebardsc': A bar of unpackaged chocolate. Tasty, but you can't digest it well.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'waterbottledsc': A 0.5L plastic bottle. Comes with clean water.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'milkdsc': A carton that can hold a liter of liquid.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'chocolatemilkdsc': A large plastic bottle that holds up to a liter of liquid.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'bleachdsc': A 1.5L plastic bottle, made to hold bleach.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'energydrinkdsc': A 0.25L soda can with bright markings on it.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'coffeedsc': A paper cup that can hold 0.25L of liquid.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'soupdsc': A small closed bowl that can hold 0.3L of liquid.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'applejuicedsc': A carton that can hold 0.8L of liquid. Feels... natural.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'lemonadedsc': A jar that can hold 0.75L of liquid. Surprisingly tough.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'iceteadsc': A 0.5L bottle. This one has an orange tint to it.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'alcoholdsc': Glass bottle that can hold 0.4L of liquid.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'exposedcoredsc': The dormant remains of something once animated. You could probably eat it to absorb its energy in the form of nutrients and water. It looks like it's slowly morphing into something...
originalFlatSource.'main'.'foliagedsc': Generic alien plant life. Barely edible, with a dissatisfying taste. Might make you sick. Decays fast. Often used in crafting.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'foliagemealdsc': A decent prepared food, made of crispy foliage and rudimentary filling. Won't last for long and has no fat, but it's very filling.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'dryfoliagedsc': Seems slightly more appealing to consume when it's dry. Might make you a little sick.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'glowplantfruitdsc': Bioluminescent and inedible. Has moderately dangerous toxins inside; counteracts infections. Its juice promotes chemical reactions, making it useful in crafting.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'flashlightdsc': Lights up a large area in front of it, but slowly loses battery. Use to change mode.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'emergencylightdsc': A tiny, one-time use emergency flashlight. You'll probably want to find a new source of light before it runs out. Use to toggle.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'lanterndsc': A simple, wood and glass lantern with a bright yellow crystal inside of it.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'lightbulbdsc': An electric light with a filament that is heated until it glows. Seems to be battery powered. Don't put it in your mouth.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'nutrientbardsc': Solid, edible bar of pure nutrients and calories. Neutral taste, and doesn't spoil.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'primitivediggingtooldsc': A piece of sharp, heavy metal on a stick. Better at digging than claws.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'makeshiftdiggingtooldsc': A piece of thrown together and tied up metal, made for digging through rock. It's a bit flimsy.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'makeshiftheadlampdsc': It's just a glowplant fruit strapped to your forehead. Not exactly comfortable, but frees up some inventory space.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'shoveldsc': A tool specially crafted to efficiently displace soil and other loose materials. While you haven't seen one of these before in your life, using it isn't exactly a science.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'woodshoveldsc': A tool specially crafted to efficiently displace soil and other loose materials. Made with a brittle, yet light material.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'pitchforkdsc': An agricultural tool used to pitch loose material, such as hay, straw, manure, or leaves. Made of steel.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'woodpitchforkdsc': An agricultural tool used to pitch loose material, such as hay, straw, manure, or leaves. Made of wood.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'minilaserdrilldsc': A small, consumer-grade laser drill. Not the best at digging, but uses no stamina.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'heavydrilldsc': A big, heavy, mechanical handheld drill. Very efficient, though lacks range.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'pickaxedsc': A tool specially crafted to dig rock. Very efficient at removing terrain, though slow.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'titaniumpickaxedsc': A finely crafted tool, made out of forged titanium. Very durable and efficient at removing terrain, though not very combat capable.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'titaniummultitooldsc':
A small, yet very firm and durable tool used for crafting, with a heavy hammer top and a tiny yet razor sharp blade hidden in the handle. While not useful for digging nor combat, it will last nigh indefinitely for all sorts of crafting recipes, and is light.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate severely infected limbs.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'titaniummachetedsc':
A very capable and durable tool for combat, both easy and light to swing, yet razor-sharp and devastating. Its edge is heat treated to keep its sharpness for a long time. An amazing tool for self defense, and can be used as a digging tool as a last resort.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate severely infected limbs.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'sledgehammerdsc': A tool with a large, flat metal head, attached to a long handle. Not made for digging.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'woodpickaxedsc': A pickaxe made out of a particularly disappointing material. Efficient at removing terrain, but slow and brittle.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'wooddiggingtooldsc': A piece of sharpened wood on a stick. Barely better at digging than claws.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'machetedsc':
A big, broad metal blade. Would do well in melee combat. You feel uneasy holding it.

<color="red">Can be used in the health panel to amputate severely infected limbs.
originalFlatSource.'main'.'crudecleaverdsc':
Cobbled together metal cleaver, with a blade nailed onto the handle. Would do well in crafting. You feel uneasy holding it.

originalFlatSource.'other'.'lowgradestimulantdsc': Unrefined stimulating hard drug. Dodgy. Gives you a pretty nice kick, but overdose and the subsequent crash is extremely debilitating. Dosage is unknown. Use with caution.

originalFlatSource.'other'.'painkillersdsc': Opioid pills used to treat pain. Overdose at 60ml.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'disinfectantdsc': Basic antiseptic fluid. Counteracts infections and stings a little.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'ringersolutiondsc': Solution of several salts dissolved in water for the purpose of creating an isotonic solution relative to the body fluids of an animal. Good for thirst and blood loss.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'salinedsc': Mixture of salt and water, often used in treating hypovolemia and thirst.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'antivenomdsc': A treatment for envenomation, it's composed of antibodies that disable hemotoxins in the bloodstream. Works intravenously.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'blooddsc': Yellow blood. While the color seems normal to you, it's apparently a side effect of the bio-engineering process. Used in treating hypovolemia.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'redblooddsc': Red blood. It looks odd to you, and the smell reminds you of your captors. Can treat hypovolemia, but your body won't take it well.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'alienblooddsc': Yellow blood from an alien. While it looks similar to yours, it visibly differs a bit. Shouldn't be too bad to use as replacement blood, though.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'antiserumdsc': Blood serum containing antibodies to fight off most common infections. Increases immunity and helps reduce sepsis. Slightly increases blood volume.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'antibioticsdsc': Pills which increase your immunity for some time, counteracting all infections. Upsetting taste.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'sleepingpillsdsc': Potent sleeping pills. Lets you sleep in bad physical condition. Don't combine with opioids.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'procoagulantdsc': Chemical which promotes blood clotting. Globally slows down blood loss, including internal bleeding. Will cause complications if overused.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'epinephrinedsc': Pure adrenaline. Reduces pain for a while and has a low chance to restart the heart if it stops. Going over 40ml will cause fibrillation.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'oxylinedsc': Synthesized reagent that quickly reoxygenates the bloodstream when injected, also stabilizing fibrillation and promoting hemoglobin production. Has explosive tendencies when mixed with stomach acid.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'antidepressantsdsc': Potent antidepressant pills. Makes you feel everything less for some time, and slowly increases happiness. Might have side effects.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'antiraddsc': Experimental medicine that directly reduces the effects of radiation sickness when taken. Will require higher dosage for severe illness.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'braingrowdsc': Special orally-taken medicine that stimulates brain regrowth. Increases brain integrity, but often has serious side effects.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'mindwipedsc': Specially synthetised drug which completely wipes the brain of most of its memories and past traumas, leaving only a blank emotionless vessel with basic knowledge and survival instincts. Commonly used as a last resort on subjects which are too far gone to function or are at risk of suicide. May also cure cases of moderate-to-severe brain damage. The effect is permanent without extensive rehabilitation. Use as a last resort.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'streptokinasedsc': Blood thinner. Strongly reduces blood viscosity and breaks down clots.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'sodiumnitroprussidedsc': A medication used to lower blood pressure, useful for avoiding hypertensive crisis. Only works intravenously. 10ml per minute.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'vasopressindsc': A hormone used to increase blood pressure, useful for avoiding lethal hypotension. Works better intravenously. 10ml per minute.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'amiodaronedsc': An antiarrhythmic medication used to treat and prevent fibrillation from occurring. Will cause most arrhythmias to slowly regress, but causes mild internal damage. Only works intravenously. 20ml per minute.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'chocolatemilkdsc': A type of flavoured milk made by mixing it with cocoa solids. Very sweet and tasty, but toxic for your species. Increases happiness, consume with caution.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'soupdsc': Unidentifiable soup, though still tasty and filling.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'cerealdsc': The world's greatest invention - milk and cereal. Very tasty and filling.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'coffeedsc': Beverage brewed from roasted coffee beans. Tasty and stimulating, but rather toxic due to the caffeine content.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'biochemdsc': Advanced chemical compound that greatly promotes chemical reactions and is able to mend certain materials together, or even melt them. Very commonly used in crafting.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'groundwaterdsc': Slightly dirty groundwater. Mostly safe to drink, though slightly sickening.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'waterdsc': Slightly dirty groundwater. Mostly safe to drink, though slightly sickening.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'dirtywaterdsc': At least it's not on your body anymore. Not safe to drink.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'algaedsc': Water with dense, bioluminescent algae growing in it. Very buoyant. Inedible.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'magmadsc': Molten rock. Every single one of your senses is screaming at you to avoid it.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'oildsc': A thick, black tar. Difficult to move through. Inedible.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'sapdsc': A thick, tasty sap, produced by jungle trees. Very sugary.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'fatdsc': Liquid animal fat, gotten from flesh. Can be eaten, though not particularly pleasant. Can be processed into soap.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'soapdsc': Soap made from animal fat. Can be used in the health panel to clean dirt off of you, and slightly disinfect wounds.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'producejuicedsc': A bunch of fruit, vegetables and whatever else you could find, mashed up and mixed with water. It tastes... interesting.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'refinedjuicedsc': Cooked through, better mixed and mashed produce juice. Very tasty and nutritious!
originalFlatSource.'other'.'liquiddescription': Crouch and stand still to drink
originalFlatSource.'other'.'experimenttraderdsc': A short-statured weird dog-rat-person, with 3 soft spike-esque extrusions protruding from the back of their head. Their head looks rodent-shaped. While they're a bit awkward, they don't have any particularly unique characteristics in the context of trading. It doesn't take much trust for them to allow a hug.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'milkytraderdsc': A particularly short, fluffy white creature, with a very flat snout and short, white horns protruding from their head. Likely aquatic to some extent, judging by the pair of fins on their back. They seem rather intelligent and mildly arrogant, they'll likely have some kind of weapon on them to offset their unimpressive physical characteristics. They aren't too keen on physical affection, it might take more trust to get a hug from them.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'dunetraderdsc': Tall, wide, imposing, with muscle-for-brains. They have odd-looking fins scattered around their body, 6 spikes protruding from the side of their head and a terrifyingly large mouth littered with many big, sharp teeth. It looks like they have gills around their torso. While they're not directly aggressive, they are mostly just driven by hunger, thus they probably won't care too much about whatever trinkets you give them; You'll need to think of a better way to get on their good side.

originalFlatSource.'other'.'presetnormaldsc': The default experience. Mistakes are punishing. Knowledge and situational awareness are greatly rewarded. Time is of the essence. Your death is all but guaranteed.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'presetrelaxeddsc': A slower, more forgiving descent. Mistakes are still punishing, but are easier to avoid. You have more time to explore and consider your surroundings.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'presetparadisedsc': These caves are inarguably better than the labs. Mistakes are much less punishing, loot and friendly faces are plenty. There's little hazards or time pressure.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'presetdesolatedsc': Alone in the dark. There's little to find and hazards are everywhere. Though survivors are a rarity, the ones that you'll find will have lots to share.

originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutbasic53': You'll make a foliage bag. To do that, you'll need to make two canvases and one rope. We have given you some foliage to do so.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutbasic54': Recipes you can make are at the top of the list highlighted in white. Click on the rope recipe, then on the rope icon in the top right.

originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutbasic58': Lets take a quick look at the health panel again.

originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid1': Welcome to the First Aid Course. We will go over your body, some injuries and how to treat them.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid2': Open the health panel. You can bark at me to skip through this part.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid3': It's time to start paying attention to the big panel to the left. It might be overwhelming for a while, but we'll touch on the more important things.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid4': This is your brain integrity. When your brain dies, you die. Today you'll learn how to keep IT alive.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid5': This is your consciousness, or how aware of your surroundings you are.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid6': This is your total pain. It usually goes down by itself over time.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid7': This is your blood volume. It will go down as you bleed it out, eventually leading to death. Consider 2.5L to be around the lethal limit.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid8': This is your rate of bleeding. Fortunately, you're not bleeding right now, so there's nothing displayed.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid9': This is your immunity, a metric of how capable your immune system is at defending your body from infection.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid10': This is your stamina. Physical exertion will lower it.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid11': This is your respiratory rate. Your oxygen will lower if you don't breathe enough.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid12': This is your absorbed radiation. Don't ask what that is, just know that more than zero means trouble.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid13': This is your heartrate. You'll want to keep this above 0.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid14': This is your blood pressure. Don't let it get too high or too low.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid15': This is your blood oxygen, also referred to as SpO2.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid16': This is an ECG. It visualizes your heart rhythm. Get used to it, as you'll stare at it often.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid17': Lastly, this is the limb-specific health panel. Most of it is pretty self explanatory, so we won't cover it for now.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid18': ...It's a lot, but you can just check your moodles at any time to learn most of these. Don't worry about it too much.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid19': We will now get to some common injuries.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid20': Bleeding is likely the most common thing you will encounter. It risks infection, and more importantly, lowers your total blood volume.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid21': Your brain needs oxygen to live. To get oxygen, it needs a sufficient amount of flowing, oxygenated blood.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid22': Here's some dressing. You know how to use it, fix your bleeding.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid23': Take a look at your blood pressure. Normally it should stay around 120/80.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid24': Blood pressure is directly affected by your heart rate, blood volume and blood vessel constriction/dilation.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid25': In crisis scenarios, survival boils down to making sure your blood pressure stays at a safe level and that your heart keeps beating.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid26': I am now removing your blood. Keep an eye on your blood pressure.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid27': Your blood pressure is now really low, forcing your heart to compensate by speeding up.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid28': This only goes so far, though. With really high heart rates or really low pressures, something called FIBRILLATION will start.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid29': Fibrillation is the process of your heart rhythm getting more erratic until it stops. It kills in about two minutes.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid30': You might notice an arrhythmia moodle in the bottom left. This is a sign of said fibrillation.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid31': This is an Automated External Defibrillator. It resets your fibrillation to zero, stabilizing you for a while.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid32': Use it on your chest and follow the steps it gives you. Good luck.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid34': Now, I want you to notice something. Look at your ECG.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid35': We will sweep your heart through all stages of fibrillation. I want you to look at how the rhythm changes with it.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid36': Do you see how it becomes distinctly wavey at high fibrillation?
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid37': This is a manual defibrillator. It's similar to the AED, but can fail if used wrong. Use it on your chest.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaidfail1': Wrong spot. Use it on your CHEST.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaidfail2': Chest. Your thorax. You used it in the wrong spot... Use it on your CHEST. You want to defibrillate your heart... Which is located in your chest. How did you even get to this point?
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid38': To use it correctly, you must match the power level to how far fibrillation has progressed.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid39': This means that if arrhythmia just started, you set the power level low. If your heart is seconds from stopping, you set it high.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid40': You can determine this using the ECG and power estimation visible here. The better you align the power level, the higher chance of it working.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid41': Try doing that. Set power, charge then shock until your arrhythmia goes away. You'll get it eventually. Try using the ECG and power estimation.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid42': Lets say something goes horribly wrong. Wear this, then open the health panel.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid43': Your heart is no longer beating. The only thing keeping you conscious is the autopump you just put on. This is the worst case scenario.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid44': Defibrillators can fix this, but it'll take a while. There's a better way.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid45': Epinephrine is a special drug that can restart your heart, found in combat pens. Inject it.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid47': Theres something notable that isn't shown in the health panel, that being blood viscosity.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid48': Blood viscosity is simply how thick or diluted your blood is. Both extremes can cause issues, but extremely thick blood is more dangerous.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid49': Extremely thick blood can cause a Pulmonary Embolism, which will damage your thorax. Severe damage to the thorax will impair and eventually stop your breathing.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid50': To break the clot down, use streptokinase.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid51': Nicely done, but lets see what happens if your thorax did fail.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid52': You must increase your thorax muscle health to breathe again. This bruise kit does just that - use it on your thorax.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid53': Back in working order. Low respiration will lower your SpO2, which will eventually cause unconsciousness, fibrillation and death.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid54': One more thing to note about circulation is high blood pressure, or hypertension. It's usually more manageable, but can still be very dangerous.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid55': The main danger is the risk of stroke if hypertension becomes too severe. Try not to let your blood pressure go above 180/120.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid56': You'll feel a lot of this out with experience. You will now be given some supplies. Bark at me with [B] when you're ready to move on.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid57': We will now take a look at some more miscellaneous injuries.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid58': Dislocations are a common injury, usually acquired from bad falls. Dislocated limbs cause a lot of pain when used.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid59': You can fix dislocations by hand. Try it.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid60': You need to hit the joint back into place. Gain some speed with your hand, then [LEFT CLICK] over the joint to hit it hard.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid61': Fractures are similar to dislocations, but are more severe and need either time or special tools to fix.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid62': A splint is a very simple, yet effective way to treat a fracture. Put this splint on your broken hand.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid63': Neat. Splints speed up the healing of a fractured limb significantly. Putting dressing on the limb would also help slightly.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid64': Your limbs stop functioning when their muscle health nears zero, making it so you, for example, can't hold things with the respective limb.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid65': You can switch which hand you use as your main in the bottom right of the health panel. Try it. Note that you're not ambidextrous.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid66': Severe pain is one of the most debilitating ailments you can get.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid67': It immobilizes you, quickly worsens mood and can make you pass out from shock.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid68': Luckily for you, there's a pretty simple way to treat it.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid69': Opiates quickly reduce pain across your entire body when used. Inject the entire thing and see.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid72': Be careful with opiates - you can overdose on them easily, or go into withdrawals after. Naloxone and naltrexone can help with opiate abuse.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutaid73': This concludes the First Aid Course. We could cover more, but we believe you can safely figure out other afflictions. You may return to your assigned room.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft1': Welcome to the Crafting Course. Today, we will cover the details of procuring items and show certain common workflows.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft2': Almost everything you see is real matter and not trash.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft3': You can harvest metal from scrap piles and traps, wood from wood structures, foliage from plants, etc.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft4': Your objective will be to create a specified item using the resources given to you.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft5': We will assume you know the bare basics of crafting. Create a foliage bag using the following materials. Use the reset button if you make a mistake.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft6': First steps. Nicely done. Getting a container should always be your first goal.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft7': An important thing to note is that you can use items near you on the ground for crafting. Bark at me with [B] once you've fully absorbed this information.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft8': Lets try again with the same resources. Make a full dressing this time. You can drag any item onto the crafting button to see what recipes it can be used in.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft9': Nicely done. Dressings are very cheap to make and are crucial for your survival. They should be your priority right after getting a container.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft10': Important note - you can pin a recipe to have it permanently highlighted in the corner, using the button in the bottom right of the crafting menu. Pin the recipe for a flimsy knife.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft11': Lets add some scrap and wood to the mix. Create a flimsy knife using these resources. You can merge items in the inventory.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft12': Nicely done. Something to note is that you can favourite items to prevent them from being used in crafting recipes. You'd do this for stuff like bags, to not rip them up by accident.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft13': Press [F] on the flimsy knife you just made to favourite it.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft14': Now, try making a sterilized dressing using these items. Remember you can rip certain bags and clothing items via crafting.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft15': Nice. You might've noticed we made your INT level go up for this test.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft16': Crafting ability is tied to your intelligence level. You might've noticed that every recipe has its own INT requirement.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft17': You gain INT whenever you use a blueprint or make a recipe for the first time.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft18': You can make recipes that are up to 3 INT higher than your current INT, with progressively worse results.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft19': 1 INT higher has a 50% chance of damaging the resulting item. 2 INT, 50% chance of fully wasting material, and at 3 INT, you also damage yourself slightly.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft20': You have enough INT to make a machete now. Do that.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft21': Clever little fella, aren't you. You can further upgrade your tools with, for example, titanium alloys. Making digging tools is useful too.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft22': Lets move onto food-related crafts. Most of them require a campfire.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft23': Boil the groundwater into clean water. You'll need to make a canteen to collect it, and a campfire to boil it.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft26': Well done. We will move on to your final crafting challenge now.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft27': Make a mini laser drill and a battery to put inside of it. This is your final objective for today.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'tutcraft29': This concludes the Crafting Course. Hopefully you can put into practice the knowledge you have attained. You may return to your assigned room.
originalFlatSource.'other'.'startlorenote':
Year 2XXX 
<>
Humanity's technology has progressed significantly. Things that seemed impossible before were now commonplace.
<>
At the center of it was one company. Their progress seemed miraculous, but they guarded their secrets closely.
<>
Years ago they had created a new species: a combination of animal and human DNA they simply called "Experiments."
<>
These experiments were the perfect test subjects, close enough to humans, but theirs to do with as they pleased. They toiled over them, twisting their biology even further to suit their needs, and as the years went by, the population only increased.

None would ever see the outside.
<>
Now it seemed that the Earth could no longer contain their ambitions. With their newly devised teleportation technology, they set their sights on a gray planet teeming with life.
<>
Soon enough, tons of miscellaneous cargo and trash was sent.
<>
Due to calibration difficulties, just as much ended up in the planet's cave system as on the surface, but the project progressed smoothly. 
<>
That was, until an unknown error caused an important piece of technology to be sent deep into the caves instead.
<>
Soon enough, the scientists had devised a plan. A plan with little risk to themselves.
<>
The chances of success were low, but their living fodder was plenty.
<>
You are one unfortunate specimen.
Resistance is not an option.

originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.0.'Item1': this is horrifying. there's so many corpses... im scared. why did they send so many of us here? i dont understand. i really dont understand. they knocked me out cold with some kind of dart and forced me into a pod to be sent here. i hate this planet.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.1.'Item1': I inquired others around the ability to see our physical status in our minds, and it turns out this is something shared by almost everyone else here. Quite interesting - this is not something we've ever been able to do back in our homes. Have we been implanted with something? There are no visible attachments on any of us. I have also noted that very few people here do not share this experience, seemingly lacking whatever lets us do this. Odd.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.2.'Item1': i keep losing weight. i need to eat more to stay in shape. all this running around makes you consume calories really fast. i guess i need to be full more often.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.3.'Item1': this is horrible. this is fucking horrible. i cant do it anymore. this is a death mission. abandon all hope. there is no point to this
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.4.'Item1': i dont get why we're here. what for? i know im supposed to retrieve some kind of battery cell or something. im assuming others have the same mission. arent there more efficient ways of doing this? logically? why send us here. i miss my friends. i dont want to die.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.5.'Item1': i fell down. bad. my leg is mangled. this is really bad. trying to move at all is a pain. i need some painkillers for this.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.6.'Item1':
i overheard our captors calling us a mutated amalgamation of a "human, fox and rat", whatever any of that means. how much is there being kept from us? information wise? the thought scares me. ive never considered anything being outside of where we were raised. and now im here. i cant wrap my head around all of this.
(On the paper is what looks to be a self-portrait.)
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.7.'Item1': I have found drawing to be a decent escape to the situation I have found myself in. It seems all of us are struggling with our mental states, one way or another. It is nice to get a distraction from the harsh reality at times.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.8.'Item1': the captors will get what they deserve.

planet is good .  eat a lot of good flesh .  dune happy

originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.10.'Item1': The distribution of species here seems very disproportional. The Experiments are everywhere, yet other species like ours seem to be much lesser in numbers. Odd... Either way, I dislike the amount of casualties here. More of us need to be helped.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.11.'Item1': I was performing a self check-up following a painful incident when I noticed a dark, nodular bump on my skin. It appeared irregular in shape and was oddly multicoloured and variegated. I estimated its diameter to be approximately eight millimetres. Upon further inspection, I found several more in various locations on my body. I corresponded with a younger friend and they seemed to have none, but my older friend had many more. Should I keep track of the evolution of this potential malignancy?
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.12.'Item1': i didnt want to do it. they had a chest drain. what could i do? drown in my own blood? all i had was a stick of dynamite... if only i could be home, even just listening to the training radio, i would give anything. its not my fault. its not my fault.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.13.'Item1': i love this place! i still meet new creatures, they are so sweet! there are so many cool things here! i will never go back to the lab, long live the cave!
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.14.'Item1': dune love tasting friend .  all friend taste different .  dark fur friend is stiff .  light fur friend is chewy .  what dune me taste like ?
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.15.'Item1': hugging others makes me happier... but some of survivors refuse hugs, i think they can be appeased somehow. also sleeping next to them is much better than on the cold floor alone.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.16.'Item1':
To anyone who finds this, they can and will control you, even in this hell. With no previous alert I started to hear a loud alarm inside me, I could see a message saying "DEPTH UNSATISFACTORY" with red flashing lights materializing in the corner of my vision.

I started running, panicked, without knowing why they would do this. Only after I went into another region of this cave network it stopped. They know how much time you are spending here, they know that you'll be frightened, and they want you to die. This is all a mass genocide.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.17.'Item1': i found a weapon. a firearm. gosh... im not used to operating this thing... i shouldve been more careful during the training sessions... i have zero idea of how ive even been sent here, being this unprepared, instead of getting culled. i almost shot someone by accident. i shouldve turned on the gun safety... who am i to know. the others tend to really panic when they see you holding a weapon in hand. so maybe it would be best to put it inside of something, so that they dont see it. they think youd shoot them, they dont know your intentions. well, id think the same if someone were to point a gun at me.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.18.'Item1': im so mad at myself for acting like a dumbass with the others up there... now all of the survivors i find chase me away from their pods... man, if you knew how hard they were swearing... they tried to scratch me... and im just saying to myself: "okay, im sorry. for fucks sake, do you realize that currently every life matters? theres no room for hurting and killing each other.". i wish i was a better person... its my own fault.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.19.'Item1': dont always trust the barrels of liquid lying around. got my hands on a big minibarrel of what i thought was lemondade, but one bitter sip was enough to tell me that it wasnt. i tried to wash it down with another barrel of water, but the water made me very sick and my hair started falling out
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.20.'Item1':
today i found a few weird metal cans that had the label ripped off. i couldnt tell what it was and the liquid was too thick to pour out, but it is surprisingly filling, i feel like i just had a nice steak... i feel so sleepy. im about to drink the next can, i love these cans!
(The bottom of the paper looks like something with black chunks in it was forcibly ejected onto it.)
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.21.'Item1':
this might be a strange thing to say but I've made my peace with this situation. ive been trying to take care of myself as much as i can and trying to comfort all the others ive met down here. it makes me feel... content? even though I've gotten hurt a lot ive been able to handle it without feeling down.
i'll try to get as far as i can, and even though i probably wont make it, i know i did my best and helped as many others as i could. that's all any of us can do.
if you're reading this, don't give up, ok?
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.22.'Item1':
i have been seeing more and more of these broken down drop pods recently, kind of like the ones that they sent us down here with except these ones all exploded somehow <>
inside the wreckages i usually find some type of gun ammunition along with a gross ball of some sort of meat? 
<>
it looks awful but it might be edible???
that dune person i met earlier told me it was good to eat
i could try having some of it
<>

ate it and vomited my guts out for twenty minutes straight, worst mistake of my life <>
for the love of god, dont eat whatever that is
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.23.'Item1':
i keep having the same dream. i have huge wings and i can keep flying up and up and up. nothing can stop me. i burst through the ceilings of these caverns and out into the world beyond. it's beautiful out there but i keep flying. i leave everything behind until there's nothing but a huge void. that's when i finally realize. im safe. im free.

every time i wake up, i cant stop crying. i wish i could keep dreaming forever.

(There is a tear-stained drawing of some very inaccurate wings.)
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.24.'Item1': can the scientists really see me here? they always wanted me to say out loud what i was thinking, but here, im just talking to myself. i suppose i have the freedom to stop, but... it feels therapeutic. if i dont make it, maybe at least these notes will.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.25.'Item1':
i didnt realize how bad it had gotten until i tried to dig again and my claws just... scraped. no bite to them anymore. ive been clawing through rock nonstop without even thinking about it. i felt naked. turns out flesh isnt meant to replace tools.
<>
i kept assuming i needed a pickaxe for everything. but i figured out my machete works just fine for the lighter stuff. dirt, plants, sand, it slices right through. saves my hands a lot of pain.
<>
found a bottle labeled keratin booster. figures they planned for our parts to break down. took a sip. after a while the old layers started flaking off like fur. underneath, they felt sharper. stronger. it was weirdly satisfying watching the worn parts peel away. i like how my claws let me grip the walls better
<>
i remembered the humans. they had nails on every finger. all of them. no claws at all. it looked so wrong up close. soft. blunt. freaky how they managed anything with hands like that.
<>
i used to think that made them weak.
<>
now i wonder if that was the point.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.26.'Item1': It's full of all kinds of critters that constantly roam around everywhere. I'm a bit of a pacifist, so I try running away from them, rather than fighting them, as I don't know who's gonna kill whom first... After all, the wounds they leave in me hurt like hell... I don't know anymore... Do our captors even know what we're going through down here?
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.27.'Item1':
I took a bad fall. REAL bad. Right into a hole and couldn't climb or dig out of with my injuries. But I made it out with these bits of scrap metal, and want to let others know this, too. 

Its the cavern walls! Nothing I've found- even dynamite -seems to be able to penetrate the outer boundaries of the caverns. But they are uneven, and if you stack enough bits of scrap metal on top of each other, you can wedge them in these tiny gaps and make an entire scrap foothold. When I was bleeding out in that dark hole, I used my collected debris to make a sort of staircase to escape and find emergency supplies.

I hope you never wind up in that situation, though. Maybe you could use this trick to protect you from injury in the first place? Who knows what other nasty things are in here with us. 

Maybe you'll catch up to me and we can share strategies. 
I hope I'll be there to meet you.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.28.'Item1':
I'm feeling lonely... so I decided to distract myself:
I found some kind of miniature fax that I was able to crush open, and I pulled its paper sheets out. Then I took a stick, and squeezed one of the glowy fruits onto it. It turned out like a brush and drawing canvas! If only you know... I started drawing alternate realities where we're free and live peacefully together; without those scientist scumbags... I felt so happy, and cried for a bit.
But now I have to go: feeling peckish! Maybe if we meet each other, I'll draw you, too...? I got really good at using the "brush". I'll try teaching the others to draw, too...
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.29.'Item1':
I'm not very strong, so I've been hoping to team up with others. We'd have a much higher chance of survival that way, but nobody I've asked is interested. Everyone is scared and some of us are dangerous. There are so many traps that it's impossible to travel in large groups. I know I'm going to die for a completely stupid reason...

Humans are so cruel. I can't understand it.
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.30.'Item1':
(The note is crumpled up and crushed, as if it was meant to be thrown away.)
<>
my friend they... i think they killed themselves. after another bad fall i tried fixing up their legs but they kept telling me off. they kept shooing me away like some sort of fly, telling me to leave them alone. i didnt get it. i left to grab some of the plants here to try and bandage them up but... when i came back they had another wound. one on their arm. i still remember what it looked like, it was bad, practically ripped apart. i tried to use the plants i found to fix up the new wound but they kept pushing me away. their eyes were... looked just... empty. i told them to stop and just let me help but they didnt respond. i tried to help a couple more times and theyd shove me away until they just... stopped. i remember seeing their body relax, i think thats when they stopped breathing. i cant get that image out of my head...
<>
did... did i do something wrong? i swear i didnt... what did i do wrong? why did they do that? i... i didnt do anything. i dont understand, i dont want to die... i dont... i...
<>
...
<>
haha...
<>
its so lonely in here.
<>
(You notice faint, dried tear drops and dried blood riddled among the wrinkled up note.)
originalFlatSource.'notes'.0.31.'Item1':
(There are colorful graphics on the paper, and it doesn't appear to be handwritten)
